categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily engages in the research, development, manufacturing, and sales of ultrasound medical imaging equipment. It offers a full range of ultrasound products including high-end cart-based systems, portable and handheld ultrasound devices, and specialized ultrasound systems for various clinical applications. Additionally, the company provides technical development services and customized ODM products to strategic clients.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company possesses proprietary core technologies in ultrasound imaging, including 2D, 3D, and 4D ultrasound, advanced image processing algorithms, and high-performance ultrasound probes. It has developed key technologies such as harmonic imaging, multi-mode composite imaging, adaptive dynamic range adjustment, and AI-assisted diagnostic algorithms. Manufacturing involves strict quality control systems and advanced production processes for transducers and imaging systems, supported by PLM and SAP systems for lifecycle and production management.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include domestic and international medical institutions, research organizations, and strategic partners. The products are widely used in tertiary hospitals covering departments such as ultrasound, anesthesia, ICU, emergency, oncology, and specialized clinical fields like breast and vascular imaging. The company’s products are sold in over 100 countries and regions, with a strong presence in North America, Latin America, Europe, Africa, and Asia.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates globally with a marketing and service network covering nearly 20 countries and regions including the US, Germany, Singapore, Hong Kong, and China. It has established offices in major international markets and maintains localized sales and service teams to support global operations.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the ultrasound medical device supply chain, focusing on product design, manufacturing, and sales. It manages procurement of electronic components and materials, production planning, and distribution through direct and dealer sales channels.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include advancing high-end ultrasound technology, portable and handheld devices, specialized ultrasound applications, and AI integration. The company emphasizes innovation in image processing, probe technology, and cloud-based AI diagnostic platforms. It pursues global R&D collaboration across China, the US, and Singapore, and invests heavily in patent development and clinical validation.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through sales of ultrasound medical imaging equipment and related accessories. Additional income comes from technical development services and customized ODM product sales to strategic clients. The company also earns from after-sales services and technical support.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading domestic ultrasound equipment manufacturer with a strong foothold in the portable and handheld ultrasound market segments globally, ranking among the top ten worldwide. It competes with international medical device giants like Canon and Bard, leveraging its proprietary technologies and localized marketing to challenge imported products and expand market share.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, the company achieved operating revenue of approximately RMB 484 million, a 27% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 146 million, up 38%. The company maintains a strong R&D investment ratio of nearly 16% of revenue and has steadily increased cash flow from operations. Total assets stood at RMB 1.52 billion with net assets of RMB 1.37 billion, reflecting stable growth and financial health.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company differentiates itself through comprehensive proprietary ultrasound technologies, including advanced imaging algorithms, high-performance probes, and AI-enabled diagnostic tools. It offers a broad product portfolio from high-end to portable and specialized ultrasound systems, emphasizing quality, innovation, and clinical applicability. Its global localized marketing and service network, combined with strong R&D capabilities, provide customers with reliable, cutting-edge ultrasound solutions tailored to diverse clinical needs.
